marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots increasing to southeast 25 near midnight
then diminishing to south 15 early Wednesday afternoon. Wind increasing to
southwest 25 Wednesday evening. Scattered flurries ending near noon
Wednesday. Low tonight minus 3. High Wednesday plus 3. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 2 early Wednesday morning then
subsiding to 1 Wednesday afternoon.<br/>
